incident_memories.root_cause: SQLAlchemy async session leak during heavy search query spikes.
incident_memories.impact: FastAPI status probe returned HTTP 500; document checkout paused.
incident_memories.resolution: Reset connection pool and enforced pool_recycle=1800 with statement_timeout=5000ms.

incident_memories.root_cause: Native C++ memory accumulation in Tesseract OCR processes during multi-page PDF processing.
incident_memories.impact: OS OOMKiller dispatched SIGKILL to worker subprocess.
incident_memories.resolution: Configured max-tasks-per-child=50 and pre-warmed worker recycling.

incident_memories.root_cause: Parallel batch document ingestion exceeded upstream 1M TPM tier limit.
incident_memories.impact: Gemini API returned HTTP 429 Resource Exhausted.
incident_memories.resolution: Activated client-side token bucket rate limiter and routed low-priority tasks to secondary flash model.
